verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a local Unix-like terminal app for iOS. It exposes no network/web API whose contract an OpenAPI (or equivalent) spec would describe, so this story's axis does not fit the product category. Its automation surface is Apple Shortcuts integration, not a published API. The 404 probes for openapi.json and llms.txt only confirm that no such spec exists; they do not make the axis applicable.
